units.source_text: 好不容醒了过来，我睁眼一看，我仰面躺在地上，周围围着很多河童。

en.t: When I finally came to, I opened my eyes and saw that I was lying on my back on the ground, surrounded by many kappas.

units.source_text: 其中一只厚嘴唇上戴着夹鼻眼镜的河童，正跪在我身边，把听诊器放在我胸脯上。

en.t: One of them, a kappa with thick lips and pince-nez glasses, was kneeling beside me with a stethoscope pressed to my chest.

units.source_text: 那只河童见我睁眼醒了过来，向我打手势示意“安静”，接着对后边围着的河童招呼道：“Quax，quax！”

en.t: When that kappa saw that I had opened my eyes and awakened, it gestured for me to be quiet, then called to the kappas gathered behind it, "Quax, quax!"

units.source_text: 另有两只河童不知从何处找了一副担架过来。

en.t: Two other kappas somehow found a stretcher and brought it over.

units.source_text: 我被放在担架上，在一群河童的簇拥下，不知要被抬到哪里。

en.t: I was placed on the stretcher and, surrounded by a crowd of kappas, was carried off somewhere without knowing where they were taking me.

units.source_text: 我们安静的走了几百米。

en.t: We went on quietly for several hundred meters.

units.source_text: 道路两边的街道和银座没什么差别。

en.t: The streets on both sides of the road were hardly any different from Ginza.

units.source_text: 道路两边生长着成行的山毛榉树，树后面也井井有条的排列着装了遮阳幕布的各种商店，林荫道上甚至还有几辆汽车奔驰而过。

en.t: Rows of beech trees grew along both sides of the road, and behind them stood all kinds of shops with sun awnings, arranged in perfect order; even several automobiles sped along the tree-lined avenue.
